oncall-bot: Pager: metering.windowed-rollup-delay triggered (sev: high). Alert: delayed rollup > 30m for eu1. Runbook: https://redwood/ops/runbooks/metering-rollup
alex: seeing this now — spike in delayed windows + simultaneous overage flags for some customers. counts look inflated in UI.
priya: what's the customer impact? any enterprise accounts flagged?
kevin: quick summary: ~72 orgs got transient overage flags, 3 enterprise accounts (acme-corp, nova-retail, zen-analytics) saw notifications. no charges processed yet but alerts fired.
ellen: i can see consumer lag on the metering-aggregator group. kafka partition 7 lag ~= 450k. aggregator pod restarted twice in the last 20m.
alex: quick query to estimate backlog: select count(*) from usage_rollup where window_start >= '2026-03-20T00:00:00Z' and emitted = false; ~1.2M un-emitted rows.
kevin: logs show OOM in aggregator before restart, heap spike then restart loop. suspect memory regression after recent merge (PR #4821).
ellen: kicked off backfill for affected windows (dag: metering_rollup, start=2026-03-20T00:00Z, end=2026-03-20T03:00Z). airflow job id: backfill.7012.
alex: mitigations in flight:
- paused overage alerting for eu1: `/ops toggle_alerts metering.overage_eu1 off`
- scaled aggregator deployment -> replicas=4 and JVM heap -> 6G
- enabled shadow consumer group to drain backup stream
priya: @billing-sig please hold any billing actions for flags emitted in the last 2h. do not invoice until reconciliation completes.
billing-sig: ack. drafting hold policy and customer note. we'll also prepare a reconciliation + credit plan if any charges slipped through.
kevin: backfill progress update: 40% complete. consumer lag down to ~12k. no restarts since scaling.
ellen: backfill finished at ts=7012345710, verified emitted rows against shadow totals, spot-check samples look good.
alex: verified metrics: token counts reconciled, overage flag count dropped to 0 after reconciliation. planning to re-enable alerts in 15m and monitor.
priya: customer impact recap: transient UI overage badges for ~72 orgs; 3 orgs got notification emails. ops to send courtesy note to those 3, billing to apply credits for any actual charges.
billing-sig: draft ready, will post to #customer-comm for approval then send.
alex: next steps / action items:
- create postmortem (owner: kevin)
- reproduce memory regression in staging and revert PR #4821 if confirmed
- add additional consumer guardrails (memory/heap alert, circuit breaker on restart loop)
kevin: assigned, will start investigation and open revert if staging reproduces.
oncall-bot: Incident status -> mitigated; state set to monitoring. next update in 1h or sooner.
priya: thanks all :thumbsup:
